title: Pure Branded
summary: Pure Branded Despia Fusion build uniting Fallen of Albaz, its Branded Spells and Traps, the Despia engine, and the Level 8 Albaz Fusion Dragons with generic staples. Aluber the Jester of Despia and Branded Opening access Branded Fusion, while every Albaz Dragon sent to the GY searches or Sets follow-up during the End Phase.

summary.title: Starters
points: Aluber the Jester of Despia searches any Branded Spell or Trap on Normal or Special Summon, and Branded Opening discards 1 card to add or Special Summon Aluber directly from the Deck (triggering a discarded Despian Tragedy to search another Despia).
Branded Fusion (Limited) Fusion Summons any Fusion Monster that mentions Fallen of Albaz as material by sending 2 monsters from your hand, Deck, or field to the GY.

Branded in High Spirits (Limited) reveals a monster in hand to send a matching-Type Level 8 Fusion from the Extra Deck to the GY and search Fallen of Albaz or a monster that mentions it, while Fallen of the White Dragon sends an Albaz Fusion from the Extra Deck to Special Summon itself from the hand.

summary.title: Opening: Aluber (or Branded Opening) -> Mirrorjade + Branded in Red
steps: Normal Summon Aluber the Jester of Despia (or Special Summon it via Branded Opening) to search Branded Fusion.
Activate Branded Fusion, sending Fallen of Albaz and a DARK monster (such as Despian Tragedy) from the Deck to the GY to Fusion Summon Lubellion the Searing Dragon.
Use Lubellion's on-summon effect (discard 1 card) to shuffle Fallen of Albaz from the GY and Lubellion itself into the Deck to Fusion Summon Mirrorjade the Iceblade Dragon.

On the field, use Mirrorjade to send another Albaz Fusion (such as Titaniklad the Ash Dragon or Brigrand the Glory Dragon) from the Extra Deck to the GY to banish a monster, then during the End Phase resolve it to add or Special Summon Fallen of Albaz from the Deck.

summary.title: End Phase Extra Deck Recursion
summary.text: The Level 8 Albaz Fusions trigger during the End Phase of any turn they were sent to the GY—whether used as Fusion Material, sent for Mirrorjade's cost, or pitched by Fallen of the White Dragon, Branded in High Spirits, or The Fallen & The Virtuous. Titaniklad the Ash Dragon, Brigrand the Glory Dragon, and Sprind the Irondash Dragon add or Special Summon Fallen of Albaz from the Deck. Albion the Branded Dragon, which Set Branded Spells/Traps this way, is Forbidden since October 2026.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Mirrorjade the Iceblade Dragon sends an Albaz Fusion from the Extra Deck to the GY as cost to non-target banish 1 monster on the field as a Quick Effect, and destroys all monsters your opponent controls during the End Phase if it leaves the field because of an opponent's card.

Rindbrumm the Striking Dragon negates any Extra Deck monster's activated effect and bounces a monster on the field, Albion the Sanctifire Dragon revives 2 monsters from the GYs (1 to each field) on the opponent's turn, and The Dragon that Devours the Dogma shuffles GY and banished cards back.

Despian Quaeritis drops the ATK of all non-Level 8+ Fusion Monsters on the field to 0 as a Quick Effect, and Alba-Lenatus the Abyss Dragon Contact Fuses Fallen of Albaz with any number of Dragons on either field.
Note: Branded Fusion and Branded Opening lock your Extra Deck into Fusion Monsters for the turn.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Branded in Red returns a Despia or Fallen of Albaz from your GY to the hand and immediately Fusion Summons a Level 8+ Fusion Monster by banishing materials from your hand or field (summoning Guardian Chimera or another Albaz/Despia Fusion with Ad Libitum of Despia to revive Mirrorjade).

Branded Lost prevents your Fusion Summons from being negated, stops the opponent from activating cards or effects when a monster is Fusion Summoned, and searches Fallen of Albaz or a monster that mentions it once per turn.

The Fallen & The Virtuous sends an Albaz Fusion from the Extra Deck to destroy a card on the field, Branded Banishment revives a Despia or Level 8+ Fusion and fuses using monsters from either field, and Branded Retribution negates any effect that Special Summons.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Secondary Dogmatika, Tri-Brigade, and Swordsoul packages featured in the lore page's cross-archetype lines are omitted in favor of the pure Branded Despia core.

main: Fallen of Albaz
Summoned: discards a card to Fusion Summon using itself and a monster on either field.
Fallen of the White Dragon
2026 support that counts as Fallen of Albaz: sends an Albaz Fusion from the Extra Deck to summon itself from the hand. Its Ecclesia summon needs Dogmatika cards this build leaves out.
Aluber the Jester of Despia
Summoned: searches a Branded Spell/Trap; comes back from the GY to negate a monster when your Fusion is removed.
Despian Tragedy
Sent to the GY or banished by an effect: searches a Despia monster; from the GY, Sets a Branded Spell/Trap.
Albaz the Ashen
Counts as Fallen of Albaz, grows with your GY, and shields your other monsters from targeting.
Albion the Shrouded Dragon
Its name becomes Fallen of Albaz on the field and in the GY. Sends Albaz or a Branded Spell/Trap from the hand to summon itself, or from the Deck to cycle.
Dramaturge of Despia
Negates a monster whenever an Extra Deck monster arrives; returns after being used as Fusion material.
Ad Libitum of Despia
Used as Fusion material, revives a Despia or Level 8 Fusion.
Branded Fusion
Limited. Fusion Summons an Albaz Fusion using two monsters from the hand, Deck or field.
Branded Opening
Limited. Discards to add or summon a Despia monster from the Deck.
Branded in Red
Returns a Despia or Albaz from the GY to the hand, then Fusion Summons by banishing materials.
Branded in High Spirits
Limited. Sends a Level 8 Fusion from the Extra Deck to search Fallen of Albaz or a monster that names it.
The Fallen & The Virtuous
2025 support. Sends an Albaz Fusion from the Extra Deck to destroy a card.
Branded Lost
Makes your Fusion Summons unanswerable and searches an Albaz card when you Fusion Summon.
Despia, Theater of the Branded
Field Spell: Fusion Summons a Level 8+ Fusion, and revives one when a Fairy leaves the field.
Branded Retribution
Counter Trap: returns Albaz Fusions to negate a summoning effect.
Branded Banishment
Revives a Despia or Level 8 Fusion, then Fusion Summons with the opponent's monsters.
extra: Mirrorjade the Iceblade Dragon
Sends an Albaz Fusion from the Extra Deck to banish a monster on either turn; leaving the field, wipes their monsters.
Titaniklad the Ash Dragon
Albaz + a 2500+ ATK monster; in the GY, fetches Fallen of Albaz at the End Phase.
Lubellion the Searing Dragon
Albaz + a DARK monster: Fusion Summons again by shuffling materials.
Alba-Lenatus the Abyss Dragon
Albaz + Dragons by contact; attacks once per material.
Rindbrumm the Striking Dragon
Negates an Extra Deck monster's effect and bounces a monster.
Brigrand the Glory Dragon
Can't be destroyed by battle; in the GY, fetches Fallen of Albaz at the End Phase.
Sprind the Irondash Dragon
Clears its column; in the GY, fetches Fallen of Albaz at the End Phase.
Despian Quaeritis
Zeroes every monster's ATK except Level 8 Fusions.
Despian Proskenion
Steals or banishes an Extra Deck monster from the opponent's GY.
Albion the Sanctifire Dragon
Albaz + a LIGHT Spellcaster: can't be targeted; revives two monsters, one to each field, on their turn.
The Dragon that Devours the Dogma
Albaz + a LIGHT or DARK monster + an Effect Monster: shuffles GY and banished cards back.
Ecclesia and the Dark Dragon
Level 8 Synchro: protects your monsters, recycles Albaz/Dogmatika monsters, and provides Quick Effect disruption.
